name: mcq-trainer
description: MCQ Trainer — multiple choice questions, import your own JSON.

scripts.sync: npm run copy:www && cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
